| [Process First-Aid Kit](SKILL.md) | Agent Skill | Capture an ad-hoc plant process issue (ramp-up problem, trouble-shooting case, unexplained process behaviour, "the diameter keeps oscillating") in a structured first-aid request and route it: make the problem S.M.A.R.T., record process, machine and existing data, pick data scenario A or B, name who benefits, then send it to a one-off analysis, to use case intake (recurring need) or back as a data gap. Use when a plant raises a process issue with no use case yet, asks for the Process First-Aid Kit, or when a one-off analytical request must be scoped before analysis starts. Drafts only; commits no cost and connects nothing. Not for a recurring need (funnel-use-case), a permanent machine connection (mi-equipment) or a dashboard change request (dept-intake). |
